text:
Complete phosphocreatine resynthesis after very high-intensity exercise normally takes about 3–5 minutes, with roughly half restored in about 30 seconds. Neither option in the team note is correct: "about 10 seconds" is far too fast, and "about 30 minutes" is too slow. The note's claim that resynthesis is instantaneous and needs no mitochondrial involvement is also wrong, since it depends on aerobic ATP production.

CONFIDENCE: 75
